name: Chanterelle Mushroom
siboNotes: Chanterelles are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're naturally low FODMAP and don't contain problematic fibers that feed bacteria.
preparationTips: Clean gently with damp paper towel rather than washing to preserve texture
Sauté over medium-high heat to remove excess moisture before adding other ingredients
Don't overcrowd the pan when cooking to ensure proper browning
Store in paper bag in refrigerator and use within 3-5 days for best quality
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin D and B vitamins
Good source of potassium and copper
